task_id.description: Defaults to the task file stem when valid. Lowercase letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-'; not '..' anywhere and not a Windows device name (con, prn, aux, nul, com1-9, lpt1-9), with or without an extension.

repo_root.description: Absolute path. Defaults to the Git top-level of the current working directory.

base_commit.description: Defaults to the resolved checkout HEAD; tracked uncommitted edits are excluded.

context_paths.description: The few files to read first; same path rules as allowed_changed_paths. Defaults to allowed_changed_paths, which is empty for analyze and review, so name them there.

allowed_changed_paths.description: Exact repo-relative paths or a trailing /** directory boundary; no other wildcards. Rejected: absolute paths, '..' components, any ':' (drive letter or NTFS stream) and any .git component. Required for every mode: use [] for analyze and review (any entry is rejected); implement needs at least one entry.

review_required.description: Default true. False makes a completed result IMPLEMENTED instead of REVIEW_PENDING.

model.description: Null, or one model identifier of at most 128 characters: no whitespace, not starting with '-'. The run command's --model overrides it.

max_turns.description: Budget of focused work steps told to the worker for one segment (1-12); not a Codex turn cap.

max_total_turns.description: Ignored. Accepted so that a task file written for 1.0.0 still loads; the bridge enforces no task-wide turn ceiling.

max_extensions.description: Caps automatic continuation grants when auto_continue is enabled; manual continuation count remains unbounded.

copy_ignored.description: Repo-relative git-ignored files, folders or globs to copy into the worktree before launch, up to 200 MB total. Tracked paths, links and repository escapes are refused; the path rules of allowed_changed_paths apply, wildcards allowed. Only for implement and test tasks; analyze and review must leave it empty.

auto_continue.description: Maximum automatic continuation grants after measurable worktree progress, capped by max_extensions when supplied.

validation_command.description: Argument array run by the bridge after the worker finishes. Required (not null) for implement and test; optional for analyze and review.

validation_timeout_seconds.description: Seconds for the bridge's validation run (1-1800); allow the real runtime plus margin.

auto_review.description: Null follows the user's auto-review setting. False turns Codex auto-review off for this task. True cannot turn it on: while the user setting is off it is ignored with a warning.

description: Task contract, for documentation and editors. The bridge does not read this file: its own validator decides and is stricter about paths and number types than a schema can express.

ignoredPath.description: A repo-relative path: not absolute, no '..', no ':' (drive letter or NTFS stream), no .git component. Wildcards are not restricted here.

allOf.description: Only a trailing /** directory boundary is allowed as a wildcard.
